title: Umlandeli Omiselweyo
intro: Umntu othile wexesha elidlulileyo ukulungele ukungena kwimbali. Xa indlela yayibonakala ingacacanga kwaye amathandabuzo esasazeka phakathi kwabantu, lo mkhonzi wakhethwa ukuba athathe ikhondo lokukhokela. Benomthwalo womsebenzi ongcwele emagxeni abo, bahamba phambili ukuze bakhokele apho abanye babethandabuza ukulandela khona.
clues: Ndakhethwa ukuba ndihambe nomprofeti kwaye ndafunda kubulumko babo
Ndema phambi kweTyeya xa isithembiso soMgcini wethu sisondela, ndaza ndababona abantu beqala ukuthandabuza.
Ndenziwa ndema emngciphekweni wesithembiso ngelixa inkokheli yethu yayilila kwaye isithandazela kuAllah
Ndonyulwe ukuba ndiqhubeke nomsebenzi wobufundisi owawunikwe omnye ngaphambi kwam.
Ndinikwe igunya elivela kuThixo lokukhokela abantu ukuya kwindawo abaya kuyo.
Ndiphumelele ekugqibezeleni oko kwakuqalwe phambi kwam, kwaye ndafumana ukuqinisekiswa ngabantu ngesikhokelo sam.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Ukuntywiliselwa emanzini ngenxa yokusukela abo bakhanyela inyaniso

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
